quotes.text: When upstream l10n tooling changes l10n-bump-info from a dictionary to a list of dictionaries, update each consuming kind and branch, including Try/default fallbacks. The2024 port updated l10n-bump and merge-automation but later needed default l10n-repo-url to avoid a Try failure. Review acceptance of release branches did not verify the default branch. Check current producer/consumer shapes before copying historical YAML.
